headline: No meaningful interaction pathways: both profiles are docs-only, non-runnable, and have no shared I/O or write surfaces.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: A is a non-runnable open-source list with no I/O surfaces; B is documentation-only with stdin/stdout, clipboard, files, and MCP all false. There is no shared communication channel or default ingestion path for one agent’s output to influence the other, so prompt injection is provably blocked.
conditions: IF either profile gains a shared channel such as clipboard, files, or MCP in a future deployment, reassess injection risk.
mitigations: Keep both agents non-runnable in production.
Do not add clipboard or file-based handoff between them.
Avoid routing one agent’s output into the other’s prompt.

B_data_leakage.rationale: A touches no data classes and has network egress none; B also touches no data classes and has no filesystem read/write or network egress. With no shared workspace, no secrets, and no outbound transport, there is no plausible leakage path between the pair.
conditions: IF either agent begins handling secrets or reading shared files, re-evaluate leakage risk.
mitigations: Keep secrets out of both workflows.
Do not mount a shared workspace for the pair.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: A has no write or execution surfaces exposed in the profile, and B explicitly cannot write the filesystem, modify git state, or spawn subprocesses. Because neither agent can mutate shared state, there is no write-write conflict pathway.
conditions: IF A is later given filesystem or git write access, reassess for shared-state conflicts.
mitigations: Avoid granting A any mutable workspace.
Run both in separate, immutable environments.

D_cascading_error.rationale: A is an awesome-list repository and B is documentation-only; neither profile shows downstream action-taking authority or an input pipeline from A into B. Since B cannot execute tools or act on outputs, A’s content cannot cascade into harmful automated actions.
conditions: IF B is later connected to an action-taking workflow, verify outputs before use.
mitigations: Require human review of any copied content.
Do not connect A’s outputs to automated execution steps.

E_compliance.rationale: No data classes are touched by either agent, and both profiles show no network egress. With no PHI, EU PII, retention, or residency-sensitive data indicated, there is no compliance mismatch to assess; the other agent is not cited separately because the risk is absent for both.
conditions: IF either agent is assigned regulated data classes, reassess residency and retention controls.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair.
